draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out about this. Two separate charges in the same month usually happen when your workspace's member count crosses a plan threshold partway through your billing cycle. In that case, you'd see a prorated charge for the added member(s) covering the rest of the current cycle, in addition to your regular renewal charge — so the two amounts ($135 and $27) would reflect different line items rather than a duplicate charge.

To confirm this is what happened, you can check Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge should appear as a separate line item with its own description. If you review it there and the two charges turn out to be for the exact same amount on the exact same day, that would indicate a billing error, and we'd want to look into it further — just let us know and we'll escalate it.

Let us know what you find, or if you have any other questions!

Best,
Loopwise Support
